solution:

The High Seas Treaty (BBNJ Treaty) came into force on January 17, 2026, becoming the world's first legally binding global agreement to protect marine biodiversity in international waters.

question:

question:

question:

Explanation: Hathigumpha inscription, which is the only source to know the history of Kharavela's kingdom, according to it, 300 years before the writing of the inscription, around 344 BC. question:
Pine, fir, spruce, cedar, larch and cypress are the famous timber-yielding plants of which several also occur widely in the hilly regions of India. All these belongs to 
देवदार, फर, स्प्रूस, लार्च और सरू के प्रसिद्ध लकड़ी के पौधें हैं, कई पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में भी व्यापक रूप से पाए जाते है।
solution:
‘अनावृत्तबीजी’(Gymnosperm)ऐसे पौधों और वृक्षों को कहा जाता है जिनके बीज फूलों में पनपने और फलों में बन्द होने के बजाय छोटी टहनियों या शंकुओं में खुली अवस्था में होते है। यह दशा ‘आवृत्तबीजी’ (Angiosperm)वनस्पतियों से विपरीत होती है जिन पर फूल आते हैं और उनके बीज अक्सर फलों के अन्दर रहकर पनपते है। अनावृत्तबीजी वृक्षों का सबसे बड़ा उदाहरण कोणधारी पौधे है जिनकी श्रेणी में अल्पाइन, देवदार, स्प्रूस लार्च, साइप्रस आदि आते है। ऐसे पौधे उच्च अक्षांशीय क्षेत्रों में पाये जाते है।
‘Gymnosperm’ is said to be those plants and trees whose seeds, instead of growing in flowers and being closed in fruits, are in the open state in small twigs or cones. This condition is opposite to that of 'angiosperm' plants, which bear flowers and their seeds often grow inside the fruits. The biggest example of gymnosperm trees are angular plants, which include alpine, cedar, spruce, larch, cypress etc. Such plants are found in high latitude areas.

question:

question:

व्याख्या–आइन्सटाइन के सापेक्षिकता के सामान्य सिद्धांत के अनुसार जब प्रकाश न्यूट्रॉन तारे अथवा ब्लैक होल जैसे विशालकाय पिण्डों से होकर गुजरता है तो उसकी ओर आकर्षित होता है। अत: कथन (1) सही है। जबकि ब्रह्मण्ड लगातार फैल रहा है, इसका संबंध अमेरिकी खगोलविद् हब्बल के सिद्धांत से है न कि सापेक्षिकता के सिद्धांत से, अत: कथन (2) सही नहीं है। कथन (3) पदार्थ अपने चारो ओर के दिक्काल को विकुंचित (वार्प) करता है सापेक्षिकता के सिद्धांत के अनुसार सही है। अत: स्पष्ट है कि विकल्प (c) सही उत्तर है।

question:

It combines with potassium of blood and sodium of plasma to form potassium bicarbonate and sodium bicarbonate. 7% of CO₂ is also transported in the form of carbonic acid.CO2 + H2O + Na2CO3   -  2MNaHCO3  (Sodium Bicarbonate)CO2 + H2O – H2CO3 (carbonic acid)

question:
In the context of proposals for the use of hydrogen-enriched CNG (H-CNG) as fuel for buses in public transport, consider the following statements:1  The main advantage of the use of H-CNG is the elimination of carbon monoxide emissions.

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

1.गलत – H-CNG कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड को पूरी तरह समाप्त नहीं करता, केवल कम करता है।

4.गलत – H-CNG, CNG से महंगा होता है।

2.Correct – H-CNG reduces CO₂ and hydrocarbon emissions, making it cleaner than CNG.
3.Correct – Hydrogen can be blended with CNG up to about 20% by volume.
4.Incorrect – H-CNG is more expensive, not cheaper than CNG.

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.The teacher says, "Magnets attract objects made of iron."
options: The teacher says magnets attracts objects made of iron
The teacher said that magnets were attracting objects made of iron
The teacher says that magnets attract objects made of iron
The teacher said that magnets attracted objects made of iron
solution:
उपरोक्त direct speech का sentence assertive sentence में है। इसका indirect में परिवर्तित करने के लिए निम्न परिवर्तन होगा-
(i) comma व inverted comma के स्थान पर conjunction 'that' का प्रयोग होगा। 
(ii) reporting verb (says) present tense में है अतः reported speech के tense में काई परिवर्तन नहीं होगा। Correct indirect sentence- The teacher says that magnets attract objects made of iron.
The above direct speech sentence is in an assertive sentence. To convert it into an indirect one, the following changes will be made:(i) The conjunction 'that' will be used in place of the comma and inverted comma.(ii) The reporting verb (says) is in the present tense, hence there will be no change in the tense of the reported speech.Correct indirect sentence: The teacher says that magnets attract objects made of iron.

question: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.They will put away their woollens after the festival of Holi.
options: Their woollens have been away after the festival of Holi.

Their woollen will be put away after the festival of Holi.

solution:
उपरोक्त वाक्य में Will +Verb¹ के प्रयोग से स्पष्ट है कि वाक्य Future Indefinite में है अतः इसका Passive Structure निम्न होगा। Active Voice- sub + will/shall + VI + object Passive Voice - object + will be/shall be + V³ + by + subject Correct Passive Sentence- Their woollens will be put away after the festival of Holi.
The use of 'will' + verb¹ in the above sentence clearly indicates that the sentence is in Future Indefinite, so its passive structure will be as follows: Active Voice - sub + will/shall + VI + object Passive Voice - object + will be/shall be + V³ + by + subjectCorrect Passive Sentence - Their woollens will be put away after the festival of Holi.

question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence. If substitution is required, select no. improvement. I look for a better job for the last two months, but nothing is in sight.
options: have been looking for a better job
solution:
उपरोक्त वाक्य में for + time का प्रयोग हुआ है। इसलिये यह वाक्य Perfect Continuous में होना चाहिये। आगे की Clause में is दिया हुआ है, जो कि दर्शाता है कि वाक्य Present में है। अत: वाक्य के Present Perfect Continuous में होने के कारण इसी tense की पत्ज्ग्हु Helping Verb व main verb का प्रयोग होना चाहिए। जोकि- has/have + been + verb + ing है।Correct Sentence - I have been looking for a better job for the last two months, but nothing is in sight.
In the above sentence, for + time has been used. Hence, this sentence should be in Perfect Continuous. In the next clause, is is given, which shows that the sentence is in Present. Hence, since the sentence is in Present Perfect Continuous, the helping verb and main verb of the same tense should be used. Which is - has/have + been + verb + ing.Correct Sentence - I have been looking for a better job for the last two months, but nothing is in sight.
